body: This is reproducible by having two repositories both running SLM policies and then just having one be empty or whatever so that no snapshots need to be deleted from it during a run. I'll deal with this, I accidentally broke this when I made SLM move to concurrent deletes.

issue.title: Fix Bug in Multiple Repo SLM Retention

labels.name: :Data Management/ILM+SLM
labels.description: DO NOT USE. Use ":StorageEngine/ILM" or ":Distributed Coordination/SLM" instead.

labels.name: Team:Data Management (obsolete)
labels.description: DO NOT USE. This team no longer exists.

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
We have to not try to create a delete run for repos that have nothing to delete.
Also, added an assertion to make sure we don't try to create broken `GroupActionListener`
which is always a bug. Adding the assertion allows testing this in an integration test easily (it's hard to test this by its effects of breaking the snapshot deletion since the loop over the repositories that was broken is not ordered by repository name so half the time this would just run into a logged warning but not a broken retention run).

closes #70029
